meta.title: dsh-xmm-ai
meta.description: Exposes the WorkBuddy models connected by dsh-connect-workbuddy through an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API at /plugins/dsh-xmm-ai/v1 (GET /v1/models and POST /v1/chat/completions, with streaming). Requests run through the Harness LLM service, reusing the signed-in accounts, credits and model roster. A sidebar entry opens a page for editing the API key, default region and remote-access settings; changes take effect immediately.
